# TITLE 9. NETWORK EXPOSURE AND OPEN PORTS # SUBTITLE LINUX SECURITY HANDBOOK # BADGES PAGE 9 OF 20 # SECTION_HEADINGS - LISTENING SOCKETS - TCP AND UDP EXPOSURE - SS - LSOF - IDENTIFYING PROCESSES BEHIND PORTS - LOOPBACK VERSUS PUBLIC INTERFACES - UNEXPECTED LISTENING SERVICES - NETWORK EXPOSURE INVESTIGATION - PRODUCTION PORT AUDITING # BODY_PARAGRAPHS **LISTENING SOCKETS** Listening sockets are endpoints that accept incoming connections or packets on the system. **TCP AND UDP EXPOSURE** Open TCP ports establish connections. Open UDP ports receive datagrams. Both increase the attack surface. **SS** ss is the modern tool to view socket statistics, listening ports, and network connections. Use it to identify what is listening on the system. **LSOF** lsof lists open files and the processes that opened them, including network sockets. Useful for identifying listening ports and connections. **IDENTIFYING PROCESSES BEHIND PORTS** Find which process is listening on a specific port. Understand the service, user, and risk associated with that process. **LOOPBACK VERSUS PUBLIC INTERFACES** Services bound to 127.0.0.1 are only accessible locally. Services bound to 0.0.0.0 or public IPs are accessible from the network or internet. **UNEXPECTED LISTENING SERVICES** Unexpected or unnecessary services listening on ports may indicate misconfiguration or potential compromise. Always review and minimize exposed services. **NETWORK EXPOSURE INVESTIGATION** Investigate open ports, services, and connections. Correlate with logs and configurations to assess the security impact. **PRODUCTION PORT AUDITING** Regularly audit open ports and listening services. Validate that only required services are exposed. Document, monitor, and review continuously. # IMPORTANT_FILES (No specific file paths listed on this page) # TABLES | Topic | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **LISTENING SOCKETS** | Listening sockets are endpoints that accept incoming connections or packets on the system. | | **TCP AND UDP EXPOSURE** | Open TCP ports establish connections.
